_doc: Single source of truth for the estimation design. R reads this via code/utils/spec_config.R; Python via code/utils/spec_config.py. Do not hard-code control lists in individual scripts -- read them from here.
_status: Baseline control set is the pre-determined universal controls minus arbitrary outcome-levels, plus a per-outcome lagged DV (the outcome's own 2020 level).
_instrument_status: Current (act-based, 2026-06-26): instrument is the act-based 10-family municipality shift-share (bartik_iv_act), endogenous is delta_log1p_act_lawsuits. Built by code/02_build/01d_act_family_crosswalk.py -> code/03_estimation/01d_act_family_ivs.py, which writes data/estimation/act_design.csv (base executive design + the two act columns) AND data/clean/municipality_act_components.csv (the long muni x family decomposition, rung=='act', for Rotemberg/shift/balance/leave-one-out). The retired substance-family rungs (bartik_iv_2020_2024 / bartik_iv_fine7 etc.) are gone. cluster_id is the STATE (27 units): the leave-own-state shift is constant within a state. First-stage F approx 25.5, clears the Lee et al. (2022) tF critical value. See docs/STATE_OF_THE_ART.md.
_baseline_controls_note: Per-outcome lagged dependent variable (the outcome's own 2020 level, see lagged_dv) is appended to these at estimation time. The inherited universal controls margin_top1_top2_2020 and log1p_total_candidates_2020 were REMOVED (they were arbitrary outcome-levels); the lagged-DV rule replaces them.
_lagged_dv_pending: valid_vote_rate_2020 is now built in 01_assemble_design.py from the registered-denominator identity (turnout - null - blank); with it, delta_valid_vote_rate is null on-spec (was spuriously +0.029 p=.029 without it). log1p_n_candidates_with_votes_2020 is still not built; that outcome runs without its lagged DV.

dropped.broader_treatment: Mislabeled: only added log1p_lawsuits_no_rrc_2020 as a control; did not broaden treatment.
dropped.no_rrc_variant: Redundant: RRC (11618) already DROP in build-stage taxonomy, so bartik_iv_no_rrc == baseline.
